issue.title: resolve_cli_reference file ref lookup reloads full artifact-file index per call (~1.2s each)
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/artifact_cli/references.py::_find_file_record` via resolve_cli_reference

Repro: run sase artifact doctor on the sase project (~24k-row artifact-file index, ~180 file refs); each file:<source>:<digest> ref costs ~1.2s because the full index is reloaded and converted per call, ~150s total. Measured during plan:202609/artifact_link_backfill_reconcile_timeout.md profiling; out of scope for timeout fix.

Impact: interactive sase artifact doctor spends ~150s on sase project; slows any bulk file-ref resolution.

task_type_fields.repro: Run sase artifact doctor on sase project; observe ~1.2s per file ref from full index reload
